change_reason: v1.4 preserved 17 calculator planner failures caused by the 8192-token input context being filled (prompt_eval_count 8191 and one output token), plus two syntactically generated plans with nonexistent numeric output references. v1.5 changes only the planner/answer contract: all existing Docling output, source pages, local model, generation temperature, arithmetic implementation, and repair definitions remain fixed.

scope.retrieval: excluded; existing Docling canonical output for each frozen page is reused
scope.parser_execution: none in v1.5; no parser installation, model download, or reparsing
scope.claim_boundary: planner contract and live source-to-operation-to-answer feasibility only; not independent evaluation, RAG performance, parser ranking, policy superiority, or paper-level validation

fixed_inputs.candidate_rule: enumerate every numeric span in the current Docling page; do not filter or rank by reference answer, repair target, question ID, document ID, or post-repair effect
fixed_inputs.state_isolation: re-extract source values independently from each current state; no clean value, gold answer, repair label, or expected effect enters planner or calculator input

short_contract.source_mapping: program assigns stable extraction-order IDs s0..sN and preserves each complete original source record, including original ID and bbox, outside the model prompt
planner_view: unit when observed or generally derived
short_contract.result_ids: program assigns r0..r5 by step position; a step may reference selected s IDs and only earlier r IDs
short_contract.validation: schema, exact keys, bounds, current source existence, role and operation allowlists, topological references, operation arity, zero division, output existence, answer citations, and declared result use fail closed
short_contract.semantic_rule: format/reference/arithmetic success is not a correct plan; source audit separately judges metric, value, period, unit, conclusion, explanation, and evidence
short_contract.token_rule: before any live call, conservatively estimate prompt+schema as ceil(characters/3), reserve 400 planner output tokens and 512 safety tokens inside num_ctx=8192, and verify a maximum-bound plan fits the 400-token output budget; this is an estimate, while actual Ollama token counts are recorded

execution_sequence.gate: run only after AMD pipeline completion
run only after a recorded source audit passes AMD clean metric, values, period, unit, calculation, and evidence

repair_diagnostic.A: corrupt only the matched 2022 Cash and cash equivalents value 4,835 to 835; restore only in A states
repair_diagnostic.B: corrupt only the matched 2022 Accounts receivable, net value 4,126 to 126; restore only in B states
repair_diagnostic.alternate_route: retain total current assets, inventory, prepaid, duplicate values, and every other source
repair_diagnostic.freshness: every state makes a fresh planner call and, only after a valid arithmetic plan, a fresh answerer call; no cached no-op response

stop_rules: stop after AMD clean if planner-to-answer does not complete
do not run repair states without the separate AMD semantic source-audit gate

evaluation.request_denominator: all requests actually admitted by the frozen gates, including failed and empty requests
reporting: correct among completed with its denominator
evaluation.v1_4_interpretation_preserved: v1.4 whole-request success was 0/7 for each calculator condition and no completed calculator answer existed, so accuracy among completed calculator responses was not measurable rather than zero

preservation.raw: append-only ignored research/work paths contain input blocks, complete source registries and short-ID maps, prompts, schemas, raw model responses/failures, token use, calculations, model inventory, manifests, and checksums
preservation.backup: the persistent project path is primary storage; independent physical backup remains unverified
